title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 (negotiable Depending on experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, typically 7:30am - 4:30pm (with a degree of flexibility)

Benefits
- Company-wide bonus scheme
- Lunch provided
- 23 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Auto-enrolment pension
- On-site parking
- Collaborative and close-knit team environment

Are you a creative marketer who enjoys bringing brands to life through exceptional presentations, marketing collateral and compelling customer communications?

This is an opportunity to join a growing, design-led SME business that works with premium brands around the world. Rather than focusing on strategy creation, your role will be to take an established marketing direction and execute it brilliantly across multiple channels, helping to ensure the business presents itself consistently, professionally and creatively at every customer touchpoint.

This role would suit a confident and commercially aware marketing professional who enjoys being hands-on, can work independently and takes pride in producing polished, high-quality marketing materials.

The Opportunity

As the key marketing professional within the business, you will work closely with commercial, project and design teams to create engaging communications that strengthen the company's brand position and support ongoing growth.

You'll be given autonomy to manage day-to-day marketing activity whilst collaborating with experienced colleagues across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Communications & Marketing Materials
- Create professional customer presentations, sales decks and pitch materials
- Produce brochures, case studies and branded marketing collateral
- Ensure visual consistency across all customer-facing communications
- Develop engaging digital marketing assets

Content & Copywriting
- Create and edit compelling marketing copy
- Develop content for customer communications and email campaigns
- Produce engaging case studies and marketing literature
- Support ongoing website content updates and improvements

Internal Communications
- Create presentations and communication materials for internal initiatives
- Help ensure consistent brand messaging throughout the business
- Support the development of marketing resources used across departments

Marketing Operations
- Maintain marketing assets, literature and sample materials
- Coordinate marketing suppliers and external partners
- Manage marketing files, resources and documentation
- Handle inbound enquiries and direct opportunities to the appropriate teams

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have experience in a creative marketing, brand marketing or marketing communications position and can demonstrate a strong portfolio of work.

You will ideally possess:
- Experience in a marketing, brand or communications role
- Experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, or similar creative software
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills
- A strong eye for detail and brand consistency
- The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, self-starting approach
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to work closely with customer-facing teams
- You are willing to be accountable for the results of your work

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and turning ideas into high-quality marketing output that delivers real business impact.

Apply

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where you'll have the opportunity to influence how a growing business communicates with its customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Portfolio or examples of work, particularly presentation are welcomed as part of your application.

title: Senior Communications Officer
company: East Cambridgeshire District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a creative communicator ready to celebrate local government achievements? East Cambridgeshire District Council has an exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity!

Location: Ely, Cambridgeshire, CB7 4 EE

Salary: £34,811 to £39,481 per annum

Job Type: Full time, 12 months fixed term contract

Hours: Hybrid working, with attendance at council offices three days per week

Closing Date: Sunday 25 October 2026

About Us:

East Cambridgeshire District Council is a local government organisation serving residents across the region. We are committed to delivering high-quality, customer-focused services and have recently achieved silver accreditation from the Investors in the Environment scheme, ranking 43rd nationally on the council climate scorecard. We prioritise environmental sustainability and responsible operations while supporting our communities.

Senior Communications Officer - The Role:

You will work as part of a busy, collaborative communications team to deliver clear, consistent and engaging communications to residents, employees, councillors and stakeholders. Your primary focus will be promoting the council's achievements, demonstrating the positive impact of its services and showing how the council improves local people's lives. You will manage multiple projects, create compelling content and build positive relationships across council services and external partners.

Senior Communications Officer - Key Responsibilities:
- Produce clear, accurate and engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, briefing notes and press releases
- Develop and deliver communications and engagement plans that promote the council's priorities, services and achievements
- Create case studies, success stories and community outcomes for use across media and digital channels
- Manage and monitor social media channels, creating engaging content and responding to enquiries
- Create and maintain website content that is accurate, accessible and user-focused
- Support internal communications activities to keep employees informed about council priorities and organisational change
- Build effective relationships with colleagues, partners and media to gather information and promote council achievements
- Monitor media coverage and social media activity, identifying opportunities and reputational risks
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and report on performance metrics
- Participate in the 24/7 communications on-call rota and work outside normal hours when necessary

Senior Communications Officer - You:
- Excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Experienced in developing and delivering communications campaigns and engagement activities
- Skilled in creating engaging content across digital and traditional channels
- Confident in managing corporate social media platforms and online communities
- Passionate about storytelling and showcasing positive outcomes for residents and communities
- Collaborative team player equally confident working independently and using your own initiative

Benefits:
- The opportunity to help communicate and celebrate the council's achievements and contribution to local communities as local government transitions to new unitary authorities
- Potential to contribute to a major local government transformation programme
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
- Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Learning and development opportunities
- A supportive and experienced communications team

Closing date for completed applications: Sunday 25 October 2026

The selection process will be: Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 November 2026

To submit your CV for this exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity, click Apply today!
